title: Austin's $20M Gas Contract Bid Rules Set
summary:
*   Austin City officials finalized specifications for a major gas supply contract for the city's electric power plants.
*   To qualify, bidders must demonstrate significant financial stability, either by proving a net worth of approximately $20 million.
*   Alternatively, bidders could secure a commitment from a surety company for a 6% supply bond.
*   These new financial requirements were formally distributed to all prospective bidders for the contract.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
September 15, 1962
12:00 Noon
Council Chamber, City Hall
1051
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Palmer presiding. Roll call: Present:
Councilmen Armstrong, Perry, Shanks, White, Mayor Palmer Absent: None Present also: W. T.
Williams, Jr., City Manager; Doren R. Eskew, City Attorney; D. C. Kinney, Director of
Electric Utility The Mayor announced this was a Special Meeting called for the purpose of
considering gas contract specifications for which bids are to be opened September 20,
1962.
The City Council briefly discussed the question of sending out an addendum to the gas
supply contract for the City Electric Plants, reaffirming the opinion of the Council that
the minimum amount of capital needed to guarantee performance of the contract would be
approximately $20,000,000, but allowing bidders to either furnish a certificate from a
Certified Public Accountant showing such net worth or to furnish a commitment from a
surety company that the company would issue a six percent supply bond. The Council
reviewed in detail the provisions of the Addendum No. 3. Councilman White moved that the
City Manager be authorized to send Addendum No. 3 to each of the prospective bidders.
The motion, seconded by Councilman Shanks, carried by the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen
Armstrong, Perry, Shanks, White, Mayor Palmer Noes: None There being no further business,
the Council adjourned at 1:30 P.M., subject to the call of the Mayor.
